explain.title: How this works.

body.rep: You raise the request; the coordinator builds the real quotation in SMAC, gets it signed and accepts it here, then sends you the PDF. From there the customer decides, and chasing them is yours. When they commit you raise the dispatch request, and the coordinator checks it and approves what actually leaves the warehouse.
body.coordinator: The rep raises the request; you build the real quotation in SMAC, get it signed, accept it here and send the PDF back. The customer then decides, and the rep chases them. When the rep raises the dispatch request you check it, record how the customer is paying, and approve what actually leaves the warehouse.
